## Design

### 2026-10-10 – # October 9th: Got the idea all mapped out

**7.08h**

# October 9th: Got the idea all mapped out

I think the hardest part in any project is finding a cool **awesome** original idea  that is also feasible.  I really got into fishing recently so  I wanted to check: are there any cool fishing gadgets? Aside from a few bite detectors and cast measurers there was nothing.
So i decided to make the ultimate fishing gadget!
Here's the break down:
3 Parts:
1- The main hub:
    It will be a plastic casing attached to the rod close to where the reel is attached just on the other side, the hub will  contain a screen and around 4 buttons. the screen will display the stats and with buttons u can scroll trough all the stats and even customize the screen layout and change the settings of the other 2 parts.
2- the detector:
    it will be farther up on the rod and look like standard bite detector. for example:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/29843clWz38nHkXKkSlG9Jv9fbcc3Wsg/1fd961d67d7f518dde5a5e84234fc6b86b576e896f18f3ddac3e36cf5f6b452f.png)

but it will also have an accelerometer and a  gyroscope sensor. the cable from the hub to the detector will be fixed length (or it will be set in the hub in the settings by the fisherman). using the distance lets say r and the type of the rod (e.g. heavy fast) and the length (from the handle to the tip) (both will be set in the settings) and all the info from the sensors we can find a lot of stats. So i decided to use my physics class knowledge and find the useful stats:

![Notewise-New note 2026-10-10-1](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/29843clWz38nHkXKkSlG9Jv9fbcc3Wsg/9dac833e5ecc0152f96ef4cac33889ca0df1b82cd13f71dd158f396d90f83633.jpg)

So the gadget can track the following stats:
* strike count and nibble detection
* active time waiting in water
* casting metrics such as total cast times tip release speed swing arc and consistency, those stats are helpful for improving technique
* fight duration and force on the rod, each fight against a fish can be plotted as force-time to study how the * fish fought and maybe what made you lose the fish.
* overall time fishing and time from last cast, also average time between casts / average time from cast until * getting a bite.
The gadget will also display battery percentage.
3- the motor
it will be placed between the reel's handle and the rest of the reel housing and allow for manual rotation of the handle so you can fish like normal but also for assistance so it will be able to react with Instantaneous speed to a bite and hook the fish. So the fisherman wont have to be 100% ready to jump to the rod when the gadget beeps/says that it sensed a bite. Depending on the settings set by the fisherman the motor could also assist the entire fight and even fight entirely on it's own.

### 2026-10-11 – # October 10th: Started the work on the PCB

**6.93h**

# October 10th: Started the work on the PCB

I knew designing a Part from nothing will be hard and take time but it still surprised. Because i couldn't just follow a tutorial i needed to actually understand what parts does my gadget  need. So at first i researched to see the main parts ill need for the PCB:   a dev board, motor driver, Oled screen, power regulation from the battery that is powerful for the motor to the esp32 (the dev board)  and more.
Then i started to search what parts i need for each category and how to wire overall it took me around 4 hours. After a while i actually started the work it was pretty slow needing to double check i connected the right pins and  chose the right foot print but after about 3.5 hours of Kicad i got a semi final PCB the only thing remaining is the jack for the cable to the motor and another smaller easier PCB for the detector (for the sensors in it and the other audio jack).

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/29843clWz38nHkXKkSlG9Jv9fbcc3Wsg/96eba0135ec6f5a29ce9c05c73cc9804bd4ad39b873a6adeeccfe390d88020fb.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/29843clWz38nHkXKkSlG9Jv9fbcc3Wsg/843906112672e5565c5cd5f6c3e37d737c0c0e4842091b4a30959ba9a83f15ce.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/29843clWz38nHkXKkSlG9Jv9fbcc3Wsg/52fd12e89f0668e9232100269fbba01ea26a01d70de141f1c32a6f6b5cf68f89.png)
